description: This Java source file defines the 'BlockedNamespaces' class, which manages distributed data related to blocked namespaces in an Akka cluster. It provides methods to add, remove, and check namespaces in a replicated CRDT (ORSet) distributed across cluster nodes, leveraging Akka's clustering and data replication features.

classes.name: BlockedNamespaces
classes.description: Manages distributed blocking namespaces using Akka CRDTs, allowing add, remove, and containment checks across clustered nodes.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of BlockedNamespaces with default configuration for a cluster member with role 'blocked-namespaces-aware'.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BlockedNamespaces with a provided custom configuration.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a namespace is stored in the local replica.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a namespace to the distributed set, propagating the change to all replicas.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a namespace from the distributed set, propagating the change to all replicas.
